🔥 Firebase Google Login

**Send ONLY the Firebase token:**
```json
{
    "firebase_token": "YOUR_FIREBASE_TOKEN"
}
```

Backend extracts name, email, photo automatically from Firebase.
Phone is optional and not required.

🔥 Firebase Facebook Login

**Send ONLY the Firebase token:**
```json

    "firebase_token": "YOUR_FIREBASE_TOKEN"
}
```

Same as Google - just the token!

- `exams` (array) - All currently live exams

- `is_live_exam` (boolean) - Whether any live exam exists
Each exam includes questions with subject and topic info.

Get archived (expired) exams with filtering options.

**Filters Available:**
- category: BCS, Bank, Primary, etc.
- subcategory: Preliminary, Written
- childcategory: Cadre, Non-Cadre, etc.
- subject_id: Filter by subject
- search: Search exam name
- **package_id: Filter by package** (NEW)

**New Feature:**
Students can now filter archived exams by the package they purchased. Pass `package_id` to see only exams from that specific package.

**Use Case:**
Show "My Package Exams" - filter archive by user's purchased package to show only exams they have access to.

Submit MCQ exam answers. System calculates marks automatically.

Get exam answer summary with statistics.

**For MCQ/Preliminary Exams:**
- positive_count: Total correct answers
- negative_count: Total wrong answers
- empty_count: Total unanswered
- obtained_marks: Final score
- result_status: Pass/Fail
- User's position in merit list
- subject_breakdown: Performance by subject
- topic_breakdown: Performance by topic

**For Written Exams (ADDITIONAL DATA):**
- ✅ **review**: Student's review of teacher evaluation (if submitted)
  - rating: 1-5 stars
  - comment: Review text
  - user: Student info
  - teacher: Teacher info
  - **conversations**: Full conversation thread array
    - Each message includes: user_type, message, created_at, user
    - Shows teacher replies, admin replies, and student messages
- teacher: Teacher who evaluated
- obtained_mark: Marks received
- is_checked: Evaluation status

**Use Cases:**
- Students view their answer summary
- Students see their review and all replies
- Students read full conversation with teacher/admin

**Parameters:**
- exam_id: For MCQ exams
- written_id: For written exams

request.description:
Students can rate teacher's evaluation (1-5 stars) and write a review comment.

**IMPORTANT:** This endpoint serves TWO purposes:
1. **Submit NEW review** - First time submission
2. **UPDATE existing review** - Call again with same written_answer_id to update rating/comment

**How Update Works:**
- Use the SAME endpoint (submit-review)
- Use the SAME written_answer_id
- System automatically detects existing review
- Updates rating and comment (doesn't create duplicate)
- Response message changes to "Review updated successfully"

**Security:**
- Student must own the answer sheet
- Answer must be evaluated (is_checked = 1)
- Teacher must be assigned

**Validation:**
- rating: Required, integer, 1-5
- comment: Required, string, max 1000 characters

request.description:
Add message to review conversation thread. Creates ongoing conversation between student, teacher, and admin.

**Who Can Use:**
- ✅ Students: Can add messages to THEIR OWN reviews
- ✅ Teachers: Can reply to reviews they're associated with
- ✅ Admins: Can reply to any review

**User Type Auto-Detection:**
System automatically detects:
- If user_id == teacher_id → user_type = 'teacher'
- If user.is_admin == 1 → user_type = 'admin'
- Otherwise → user_type = 'student'

**Use Cases:**
- Student responds to teacher's reply
- Student asks follow-up questions
- Teacher explains marking
- Admin mediates disputes

**Validation:**
- review_id: Required, must exist
- message: Required, max 2000 characters

**Note:** Students can add UNLIMITED messages to continue conversation

response.name: Success Response
Teacher Reply (Auto-Detected)

formdata.description: ID of the review to reply to

formdata.value: Thank you for your positive feedback! I'm glad you found my evaluation helpful.

response.name: Admin Reply (Auto-Detected)

formdata.value: This conversation has been reviewed and verified by administration.

request.description:
Get full conversation thread for a review including all messages from student, teacher, and admin.

**Returns:**
- Review details (rating, comment)
- Student information
- Teacher information
- Written answer details
- Complete conversation array with all messages

**Conversation Format:**
Each message includes:
- id: Message ID
- user_type: 'student' | 'teacher' | 'admin'
- message: The conversation text
- created_at: Timestamp
- user: User information (name, phone, etc.)

**Use Cases:**
- Student views full conversation history
- Display chat-style interface
- Load conversation thread

**Alternative:** Can also use `show-preliminary-answer` which includes review + conversations in the answer response

response.name: Success Response

formdata.description: ID of the review to reply to

formdata.value: Thank you for your feedback! I'm glad you found my evaluation helpful. Keep up the good work!

request.description:
Get all currently available packages (active and published).

**Filters Applied:**
- status = 1 (active only)
- published_at IS NULL OR published_at <= NOW()

**Returns:**
- course_base: Course-based packages (type = 1)
- exam_base: Exam-based packages (type = 2)

**Note:** This endpoint does NOT return upcoming/scheduled packages. Use '/upcoming-packages' for those.

Get all upcoming/scheduled packages that are not yet available for purchase.

**Upcoming Criteria:**
- published_at > NOW() (scheduled for future)
- OR (published_at IS NULL AND status = 0) (draft packages)

**Returns:**
- course_base: Upcoming course-based packages
- exam_base: Upcoming exam-based packages
- Ordered by published_at (earliest first)

**Use Cases:**
- Show "Coming Soon" packages
- Display scheduled launches
- Preview future offerings

**Fields Included:**
- id, name, details, permission
- amount, validity, discount_amount
- image, banner_image
- published_at (launch date)
- enroll_students_count (interest tracking)
